text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After Karen Chan asked me to help her out
with a photoshoot, I was waiting for her
at our meeting spot—

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting~!

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Phew.
I'm so sorry I'm late!

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting for me♪
Well then, let's get going!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As soon as I point the camera at her,
Karen Chan flashes her usual
"cute" smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, before this—

text_block_list.name: College Girl
text_block_list.text:
I'm here to declare war.
I might not be able to catch up to you yet,
but someday, I'll definitely beat your Uma-likes!

text_block_list.name: College Girl
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait. I'll definitely win
with the "mature charm" that you don't have.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Right, mind your fingertips all the way through.
Also, stay conscious of your ears and tail.
Make sure there aren't any wasted movements.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Karen-san, you're amazing!
You're so elegant, I'm completely mesmerized!

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Mature charm" and how to show it off!
I knew asking City-san
was the right call♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, she was supposed to be all fired up
about showing off her "mature charm," but...
choice_data_list: Did you give up on "mature charm"?
Did you drop the "mature charm" idea?

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmm... what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She didn't seem like she had given up...
As I hesitated over what to say to her question—

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ...Hey, make sure you
absoluuutely don't take your eyes off Karen, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as told, I keep snapping photos without looking away.
Then, for a fleeting moment—in between her smiles,
Karen Chan gazes into the distance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I have never seen an expression like this on her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The eyes that had always gazed right at me
seemed suddenly stolen away by something else.
Just as I am about to call out to her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Karen Chan looks back at me again
and gives a soft smile.

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. What's the matter, Trainer-san?♪

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Could it beee...
Did your heart skip a beat seeing Karen
looking a teeeeny bit different than usual?

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, you didn't feel anything at all?
Really, really?

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: *Sob*... Karen feels so lonely...

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, I knew it♪

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
You know, Karen was thinking.
If I change absolutely eeeverything,
then that wouldn't be Karen anymore.

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Karen's "mature charm" definitely
comes as a set with being "cute."

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
So, as long as people can catch glimpses of
"mature charm" inside Karen's "cuteness,"
I think that's good enough!

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Do you understand what I mean?
...Trainer-san♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her teasing tone and innocent smile.
Faced with Karen Chan like this,
there was no other choice but to nod...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, the photos from this shoot
were posted on Umastagram, gathering
a whole lot of "Uma-likes," and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A DM arrived from that college girl saying,
"A brand new charm from Karen-chan...!
But I still won't lose!"

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Karen wants you to tell me clearly, though...
Or maybe, was it still not quite enough?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It felt pretty good to me,
aren't you just one step away?

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, City-san!
Could it be... you were watching?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I just happened to be doing a shoot nearby.
Either way, you totally found your own
"mature charm," didn't you, Karen?

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, so you noticed,
City-san?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Basically, just having "mature charm" alone
wouldn't make you Karen.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Because being "cute"
is what makes you Karen, right?

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ Without that,
Karen wouldn't be Karen anymore.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So instead of just "cute,"
it's about showing glimpses of expressions and gestures
you don't normally make... every now and then.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That's what "mature charm"
really means for you.
...Right?

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: That's pretty much it☆

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm still just in the prep phase right now,
but day by day from here on out,
my "mature charm" will level up too—

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
So I want everyone to fall
eveeen more head over heels
for Karen♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that said, Karen Chan flashed
her usual cute smile.
